patch_description: This approach consolidates the 10 distinct parameters from the current high-performing circuit into 5 distinct parameters through strategic grouping: (1) ry_even and ry_odd for single-qubit Y-rotations, (2) xx_param for all XX gates, (3) yy_param for all YY gates, (4) zz_param for all ZZ gates, and (5) rz_param for all Z-rotations. This maintains the proven architectural strength—alternating single-qubit gates, diverse Ising interactions, and cross-qubit couplings—that achieved 96% test accuracy and 0.28 worst-group margin, while dramatically improving parameter efficiency. The parameter economy boost should outweigh any minor accuracy loss from sharing, since the scoring heavily penalizes distinct parameter count with no diminishing returns. The circuit retains sufficient expressivity through the two-pattern RY alternation and the diversity of Ising gate types (XX, YY, ZZ) despite sharing within each type.
